name: com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish.transport.fishnet
description: FishNet transport bridge over a Signal Fish room: the room authority plays the FishNet server, members play clients, and game traffic rides the v3 binary relay lane. Requires the FishNet asset (git URL install or vendored under Assets/; detected by versionDefines or the included editor define detector), com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish, and com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish.adapters.core.

samples.description: A NetworkBehaviour that syncs a player capsule's position and rotation over the bridge, plus the host/client bootstrap scene steps.
